name: F3K Deband
description: Removes color banding in smooth gradients while preserving detail. Wraps vszip.Deband (modern f3kdb successor) via vs-jetpack. Raise thr/radius and add grain for stubborn bands; use sparingly on detailed sources.

params.label: Radius
params.help: Banding detection radius. Larger values catch wider bands but blur more detail.

params.label: Threshold
params.help: Banding detection threshold. A pixel is considered banded if the difference with its reference is below this value. Higher = more aggressive but more risk to detail.

params.label: Grain
params.help: Grain to add after debanding. Useful for masking residual banding and matching natural film grain. 0 disables.

params.label: Planes
params.help: Which planes to process. Banding usually shows in luma but can affect chroma too on heavily compressed sources.

params.label: Sample mode
params.help: Strategy for sampling reference pixels. SQUARE (4 points) is the default; MEAN_DIFF modes use additional thresholds for stronger detail preservation.

params.label: Dynamic grain
params.help: Generate a unique grain pattern per frame. Looks more natural in motion but adds temporal noise that can hurt encoder efficiency.

params.label: Blur first
params.help: If true, compares the current pixel against the mean of references. If false, compares against each reference individually (stricter — pixel only marked banded when ALL pairwise differences are below threshold).

params.label: Random seed
params.help: Seed for grain RNG. -1 picks a random seed each run (varies between encodes); set to a fixed positive integer for reproducible output.

params.label: Random algorithm
params.help: RNG strategy used for both reference positions and grain. UNIFORM is the default; OLD is the legacy algorithm; GAUSSIAN gives a normal distribution.
